title: 3 January 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles gave their 69th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club on this day. This was also their first show at the venue in 1962, and the 15th occasion on which they performed both lunchtime and evening shows there.

The group’s lunchtime shows in the Cavern typically lasted from 12-2pm. Overall this was their 107th appearance at the Mathew Street cellar club, including their late-night shows.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows at the Mathew Street venue between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2011: Beatles museum opens in Buenos Aires, Argentina
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: National Exhibition Centre, Birmingham
  • 1976: Mal Evans writes his will
  • 1970: Recording: I Me Mine
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day two
  • 1964: Live: The Beatles’ Christmas Show
  • 1964: US single release: Please Please Me
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Two Red Shoes Ballroom, Elgin, Scotland
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1926: George Martin is born
